interface.longDescription: Keikibu aiuta i genitori a trovare eventi, attività, servizi, promozioni e articoli per famiglie con bambini. Puoi cercare per località, data, età, prezzo e tipologia e poi scegliere e contattare in un clic.

publication.release_notes: Aligned Keikibu query construction with the searchV2 16.10.0 backend taxonomy and morphological normalization. The skill no longer hardcodes singular/plural rewrites for specific seasonal phrases; it preserves the user topic wording while using structured event_type filters when explicitly expressed. Routing through search_keikibu_content, Keikibu-only source continuity, no-results behavior without web fallback, conversational follow-ups, geographic filters and card rendering remain unchanged.
